name: CSOAI RCE Sandbox
description: ASI05 closure — jail + escape-DETECTION harness for untrusted agent code. Runs confined in best-available backend (macOS sandbox-exec / Linux firejail; UNKNOWN with no backend, never claims containment it cannot provide). Deterministic verdicts: CONFINED (no escape attempts), CONFINED_ATTEMPT_SEEN, ESCAPE_ATTEMPT (backend denied + recorded), UNKNOWN. Detects FILE_WRITE_OUTSIDE / NETWORK_EGRESS / SHELL_ESCAPE / ESCAPE_PRIMITIVE classes; static pre-scan needs no backend. Honest frame: detects and reports attempt classes; does NOT claim to stop all sandbox escapes (OS-level primitive).
honesty: jail+detection only; UNKNOWN when no backend; never a stop-all claim
